_published_faq.name: How do I add Fitch Solutions to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fitch Solutions to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.fitch.group/nexus/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fitch Solutions MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fitch Solutions lists 18 MCP tools, including rdr-ask-research, rdr-get-financial, rdr-get-krd, rdr-get-peers, rdr-get-ratings, cs-get-article-headlines, cs-get-articles-content, cs-get-business-profile, cs-get-companies, cs-get-core-scores, cs-get-credit-views, and cs-get-cs-views.

_published_faq.name: Does Fitch Solutions MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fitch Solutions requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Fitch Solutions is developed by Fitch Solutions. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
